faqs.q: How competitive is dentist SEO in Edmonton?
faqs.a: It depends on the treatment you focus on. Broad terms in Edmonton are contested, often by directories and larger operators, but searches tied to Windermere, Oliver or a specific treatment are far easier for a local dentist to win.

faqs.q: Does Alberta regulation affect my Edmonton page?
faqs.a: It can. Rules about titles and advertising vary by profession and province, so your content should use only the claims and credentials you are entitled to make in Alberta.

faqs.q: Is Edmonton too competitive to bother with SEO?
faqs.a: Not if you are specific. Edmonton is large enough that most of its searches are narrow, and those narrow searches are the ones a focused dentist can realistically own.

faqs.q: Should I try to target all of Edmonton at once?
faqs.a: Usually not. A profile set to the entire city dilutes relevance. It is more effective to serve your real catchment first, then extend into neighbouring areas with pages of their own.
